title: lëndëm gi ci ginaaw tron ​​bi
intro: Yaa ngi taxaw ci biir ëttu buur bu am doole bu yàgg, fu benn njiit bu am doole wax ni mooy yàllay askan wi yépp. Ci wetu njiit li dafa taxaw benn surga bu gëm boppam, ñu dénk ko bépp bëgg-bëgg bu gëna mag ci buur bi. Ñu bokk xalaat ak pexe, baña déggal li ndaw si yónnee leen ngir jàppale leen. Ndax mën nga xam kan mooy surga bu dëggu boobu?
clues: Maa ngi dëkkoon ci biir réew mu am doole, muy njiit lu am doole, muy wax ni mooy boroomam ci askan wi yépp.
Maa ngi nekkoon ministre bu njiit li wóolu, di def bépp bëgg-bëgg ak bépp ndigal.
Bi benn Yonent Yàlla dikkee ci sunu réew di nu woo ci dëgg, man ak sama kilifa bi bañoon dégg.
Dañu ma sant ma taal xal bu mag, defar ay briki ban ngir tabax kër gu mag.
Sama njiit bëggoon na tabax barab bu kawe ba yegg ci asamaan ci boppam.
Ginaaw ga, man ak sama njiit, ak sunuy soldaar, dañu nu yóbbu, daanu ci xóotaayu géej gi.

arabic: أَسْبَـٰبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَـٰذِبًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍۢ
verse: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin. (40:37)
